events.event: Flash flooding on 23-24 November trapped dozens of illegal gold miners (gurandil) in two pits at Gunung Butak, Nanggung, Bogor; Basarnas-led search teams had recovered 9 bodies by the evening of 25 November.
events.key_numbers: 9 dead (6 from Pit A, 3 from Pit B) · 17 still trapped (CNN Indonesia 20:30; detik photo-news gives the same 9/17) · earlier count 7 dead, 19 missing at 18:44 · 26 families reported missing relatives at the DVI post · pits about 100 m deep (bodies found at 40-70 m) · rain from about 18:00 on Monday, river surge about 23:00
events.why_it_matters: Illegal mining pulls in poor villagers and keeps killing them, and the death toll is still rising.
events.spreading_evidence: Several updates on CNN Indonesia nasional on 25 Nov; multiple detik pieces; death toll rising through the day

events.event: BKN said the SSCASN portal is open and about 1.47 million PPPK contract workers can apply for CPNS civil-servant selection in 2026-2027, without their PPPK status automatically blocking them.
events.key_numbers: 1.47 million eligible PPPK of about 3.3 million · 278,241 SSCASN accounts created so far · about 3 million applicants expected (about 20 per slot) · process about 181 days, CPNS NIP targeted by 1 June 2027 · 3,995 CAT devices, about 15,980 participants per day · portal opened 17 Nov
events.why_it_matters: Over a million contract workers get a shot at permanent civil-servant status, and fresh graduates face far more competition.
events.spreading_evidence: CNBC Indonesia news item on 25 Nov; covered by Medcom, Alinea, BKN, regional outlets; ANTARA/CNBC front-page items

events.event: DKI Jakarta's transport agency fired a Mikrotrans JAK 10A driver for refusing to let a passenger with a disability sit in a priority seat.
events.key_numbers: detik most-read #10 on 25 Nov snapshot · no fine or compensation figures reported in the sources read
events.why_it_matters: Shows how priority-seat rules on Jakarta public transport are enforced, and who they protect.
events.spreading_evidence: detik terpopuler #10 (25 Nov snapshot); covered by Kompas, Okezone, Jawapos, IDN Times, Voi, Disway

events.event: Falling trees in bad weather killed people in at least two places: a man electrocuted while helping clear a fallen tree in Pekalongan and a motorcyclist hit by a tree in Musi Rawas, South Sumatra.
events.key_numbers: detik most-read #5 (Pekalongan) and #7 (Musi Rawas) on 25 Nov snapshot · 1 death each per headline
events.why_it_matters: Rainy-season storms are hitting several regions at once, and BMKG has issued extreme-weather warnings for the coming days.

events.event: Kupang Regent Yosef Lede was questioned for more than 12 hours at Polda NTT over an alleged rape case, per CNN Indonesia.
events.key_numbers: questioned over 12 hours · reported 25 Nov (22:51 WIB item)
events.why_it_matters: A sitting regional head is being examined by police in a sexual-violence case; allegation only, no ruling.

events.event: A fire at a Pertamina fuel station (SPBU) in Kramat Jati, East Jakarta, started from a car being refilled, briefly reached the dispenser and canopy, and operations were halted.
events.key_numbers: reported by CNBC Indonesia, ANTARA Banten and others on 25 Nov · no casualty figure confirmed in the snippets read
events.why_it_matters: Raises basic safety questions for anyone refuelling at a petrol station.
events.spreading_evidence: CNBC Indonesia news items on 25 Nov

events.event: Police dog units were deployed to search for victims at the Cikande, Serang factory fire, per ANTARA.
events.why_it_matters: Four days on, the search for victims is still going at the Banten factory fire.

events.event: A national road in Pesisir Selatan, West Sumatra, collapsed, cutting the West Sumatra-Kerinci route, per CNN Indonesia.
events.why_it_matters: A key inter-province road link is cut for travellers and goods heading into the holiday season.
